_doc: Acceptance (E1) and WARNING (E2) thresholds for the recentering experiment. E1 is an identity test of the frozen replay under an integer strip relabelling: any deviation above floating-point level is a FAIL. E2 thresholds are WARNINGS, not acceptance criteria: they flag comparisons that deserve inspection. They are set from the validated five-muon K2A vs S0 results (0.15-0.20 % shaped rel L2, worst U/V charge ratio about 0.7 %) and are NOT the final K2A acceptance criteria, which are frozen later, before the sealed set is opened. Every metric is also reported numerically.

e2b._doc: E2b far-D analysis flags (WARN only; informational, added for the far-D analysis; e1/e2 values unchanged)
